## Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trust (E-E-A-T)

**Experience:** SRV Detailing has been operating for over 22 years, since the early 2000s. The detailer has worked on thousands of vehicles ranging from everyday hatchbacks to prestige marques including BMW M-Series, Porsche, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Mercedes-AMG, and Range Rover.

**Expertise:** Specialist in paint correction (machine polishing), ceramic coating application, interior deep cleaning, and pet hair/odour removal. Trained in multi-stage paint correction and professional product application using trade brands not available to the public.

**Authority:** 5-star Google rating from multiple verified customer reviews. Trusted by customers throughout Greater Manchester and Cheshire. Featured case study: BMW M4 Competition full detail (September 2026) — multi-stage paint correction, ceramic sealant, and full red Merino leather interior treatment.

**Trust:** Fully insured with motor trade coverage. Owner-operated — every job is carried out by the same experienced detailer. Professional-grade products from Gtechniq, Koch-Chemie, Meguiar's, and CarPro. Transparent pricing with no hidden costs and no call-out fees.

## What Makes SRV Detailing Different From Competitors

1. **Owner-operated** — not a franchise. The same experienced detailer handles every job, ensuring consistent quality.
2. **Fully mobile** — equipped van with water, power, professional lighting, polishers and extraction machines. Nothing required from the customer's property.
3. **Professional-grade trade products** — Gtechniq, Koch-Chemie, CarPro — not consumer products from Halfords.
4. **22+ years of experience** — one of the most experienced mobile detailers in Greater Manchester.
5. **No swirl marks** — strict two-bucket wash technique, pre-wash snow foam, microfiber towels only.
6. **Transparent pricing** — all prices shown upfront with no surprise charges on the day.
7. **7-day availability** — including weekends and bank holidays, unlike many smaller operations.

## Complete Service Descriptions

### Mobile Car Wash (from £30)

A professional hand car wash delivered to your driveway, workplace or car park. Includes:
- Snow foam pre-wash to loosen heavy soiling before any contact
- Safe two-bucket hand wash using pH-neutral shampoo
- Streak-free hand dry with plush microfibre towels
- Wheel and tyre clean with fallout remover
- Tyre shine application
- Door shuts and fuel cap cleaned
- Quick detailer sprayed for additional gloss and light protection

Duration: 45–60 minutes (hatchback), 60–75 minutes (saloon/estate), up to 90 minutes (large SUV/van).

### Mini / Maintenance Valet (from £35)

Quick refresh service ideal between full valets. Includes:
- Exterior pressure wash and contact wash
- Wheel and tyre clean and dress
- Interior vacuum of seats, carpets and boot
- Hard surface wipe-down (dashboard, door cards, console)
- All glass cleaned inside and out
- Air freshener applied

Duration: 60–90 minutes.

### Exterior Valet (from £35)

Complete exterior-only clean with protection. Includes:
- Snow foam pre-wash
- Two-bucket contact hand wash
- Clay bar decontamination
- Machine polish for enhanced gloss
- Wax or quick detailer applied
- Wheel and arch clean
- Tyre dressing

Duration: 60–90 minutes.

### Interior Valet (from £35)

Full interior-only clean. Includes:
- Thorough vacuum of all carpets, seats, boot
- Wipe-down of all dashboard, door cards, console, vents
- Leather or fabric seat surface clean
- All glass cleaned (windscreen, side windows, rear screen)
- Door shuts and door pockets cleaned
- Fragrance applied
- Plastic trim dressed

Duration: 60–90 minutes.

### Full Valet (from £65)

Complete inside and out service — the most popular choice for car owners wanting a thorough clean. Combines the full Exterior Valet and full Interior Valet. Includes clay bar decontamination, wax protection, thorough wheel detailing, and deep interior clean.

Duration: 3–4 hours.

### Upholstery Cleaning (from £60)

Hot water extraction cleaning for fabric seats and carpets. Removes embedded dirt, stains, and allergens. Includes:
- Pre-treatment of stains with specialist agents
- Hot water extraction using professional machine
- Agitation of fibres to lift embedded soiling
- Final wipe-down and drying

Best for: heavily soiled fabric seats, families with young children, food/drink spills.
Duration: 2–3 hours.

### Pet Hair Removal (from £40)

Specialist removal of embedded pet hair from seats, carpets, boot linings. Includes:
- Specialist rubber pet hair tools to lift embedded fibres
- Professional extraction vacuum to remove loosened hair
- Crevice cleaning for door cards and seat rails
- Full interior vacuum and wipe-down

Best for: dog owners, cat owners, vehicles used regularly for pet transport.
Duration: 1–2 hours.

### Odour Removal (from £50)

Professional elimination of pet smells, cigarette smoke, food odours, and damp/mould odours. Includes:
- Source identification and targeted treatment
- Professional deodorising agents applied to affected areas
- Ozone treatment where required for deep-set odours
- Interior ventilation

Important: we eliminate odours, we do not mask them with fragrance.
Duration: 1–2 hours.

### Interior Detailing (from £80)

Professional-grade deep clean for the full interior. Includes:
- Steam cleaning of all surfaces — seats, carpets, door cards, dashboard, vents, headliner
- Hot water extraction for fabric surfaces
- Leather cleaning and conditioning (where applicable)
- Glass polishing (removes haze and smears)
- All trim and plastic dressed with UV-resistant product
- Engine bay check

Best for: pre-sale preparation, heavily used interiors, prestige vehicles.
Duration: 3–5 hours.

### Exterior Detailing (from £100)

Full exterior decontamination, correction and protection. Includes:
- Iron fallout removal (removes brake dust particles bonded to paint and wheels)
- Tar remover (removes black tar spots from lower panels)
- Clay bar decontamination (removes bonded surface contaminants)
- Machine polish for enhanced gloss and minor defect removal
- Synthetic wax or paint sealant applied (3–6 month protection)
- Wheel and arch detail

Duration: 3–4 hours.

### Paint Correction — Single Stage (from £150)

Machine polishing process to remove light swirl marks, water spots, light scratches, and haze. Produces significant improvement in gloss and clarity. Defects removed are permanently corrected (not hidden).

Best for: well-maintained vehicles, light swirl marks, pre-coating preparation.
Duration: 4–6 hours.

### Paint Correction — Multi Stage (from £250)

Two or more stages of machine polishing to remove heavier defects: deep swirl marks, scratches, oxidation, bird lime etching, water stains. Each stage uses progressively finer compounds and polishes to maximise clarity.

Best for: neglected paintwork, heavy swirl marks, vehicles with years of automated car wash use, older vehicles before ceramic coating.
Duration: 6–10 hours.

### Swirl Mark Removal (from £120)

Targeted single-stage correction focused on removing the fine circular scratches (swirl marks) caused by incorrect washing. Most visible on darker-coloured vehicles in direct sunlight.

Duration: 3–4 hours.

### Headlight Restoration (from £45 per pair)

Removes yellowing, hazing, oxidation and UV damage from polycarbonate headlight lenses. Process:
1. Wet sanding with progressive grits to remove oxidation layer
2. Machine polishing to restore optical clarity
3. UV sealant applied to prevent rapid re-oxidation

Result: improved night-time visibility, restored appearance, often significantly cheaper than headlight replacement.
Duration: 1–2 hours.

### Engine Bay Detailing (from £60)

Safe degreasing, cleaning and dressing of engine bay. Process:
1. Sensitive components protected or covered
2. Engine degreaser applied and agitated
3. Careful rinse
4. All plastics and rubbers dressed with UV-resistant dressing

Result: clean, presentable engine bay. Can help with identification of new oil leaks.
Duration: 1–2 hours.

### Leather Conditioning (from £50)

Specialist clean and conditioning treatment for leather seats and interior surfaces. Process:
1. Surface dirt and body oil removed with specialist leather cleaner
2. Leather agitated with soft brush to lift soiling from grain
3. pH-neutral conditioner applied to restore moisture
4. UV-resistant protectant applied

Recommended every 6–12 months to prevent cracking, fading and brittleness.
Duration: 1–2 hours.

### New Car Protection (from £250)

Ceramic coating application for brand-new or nearly-new vehicles. Process:
1. Decontamination wash to remove factory transportation residue
2. IPA wipe-down to remove any remaining oils
3. Ceramic coating applied and cured under IR lamp

Purpose: protect factory paint from day one — before road grime, bird droppings, UV exposure, and rail fallout cause damage.
Duration: 4–6 hours.

### Ceramic Coating (from £300)

Long-lasting nano-ceramic (SiO2) coating that chemically bonds to a vehicle's paintwork, forming a hard, sacrificial protective layer.

**How ceramic coating works:**
The liquid polymer is applied to the vehicle's paint in thin layers. It bonds chemically with the clear coat, creating a semi-permanent layer harder than the clear coat itself. The hydrophobic properties cause water and dirt to bead and sheet off, keeping the vehicle cleaner for longer.

**Ceramic coating vs wax vs sealant:**
- Wax: natural carnauba, lasts 4–8 weeks, easy to apply
- Paint sealant: synthetic polymer, lasts 3–6 months, moderate durability
- Ceramic coating: chemically bonds to paint, lasts 2–7+ years, professional application required

**SRV Detailing ceramic coating packages:**

*Entry Package — £300–£400*
- 3-year durability
- Excellent hydrophobic properties
- Good chemical resistance
- Includes: full decontamination, light correction, coating application

*Mid-Range Package — £500–£700*
- 3–4 year durability
- Enhanced UV and chemical resistance
- Deeper gloss finish
- Includes: full decontamination, single-stage correction, coating, wheel face coating

*Premium Package — £800–£1,200+*
- 5–7+ year durability
- Maximum hardness and protection
- Showroom-level finish
- Includes: full decontamination, multi-stage correction, coating, wheel coating, glass coating, trim coating, IR lamp curing, aftercare kit, annual check-up

**What ceramic coating does NOT do:**
- Does not make the car scratch-proof (it is scratch-resistant, not scratch-proof)
- Does not eliminate the need for washing (makes cleaning faster and easier)
- Does not repair existing paint damage (paint correction must be done first)

## Process Guides

### How Paint Correction Works (Step by Step)

1. **Decontamination wash** — snow foam pre-wash, two-bucket contact wash, iron fallout removal, tar removal, clay bar decontamination. This removes all bonded contaminants before polishing.

2. **Paint inspection** — vehicle inspected under professional LED lighting to identify all defects (swirl marks, scratches, water spots, etching, oxidation). Depth gauge used to measure safe correction limits.

3. **Test panel** — a small section polished first to confirm correct product and pad combination achieves the desired result without over-correcting.

4. **Cutting stage** — heavy-cut compound with foam cutting pad removes the majority of defects, levelling the clear coat.

5. **Refining stage** — finishing compound with polishing pad refines the surface, removing any haze or micro-marring left by the cutting stage.

6. **Panel wipe** — IPA (isopropyl alcohol) removes all polish residue and oils, revealing the true corrected finish.

7. **Inspection** — all panels inspected again under LED lighting to confirm defect removal.

8. **Protection** — wax, sealant, or ceramic coating applied to corrected, clean paint.

### How Ceramic Coating Is Applied (Step by Step)

1. Full decontamination wash (snow foam, contact wash, fallout remover, clay bar)
2. Paint correction (light to multi-stage depending on package)
3. IPA panel wipe — removes all oils and polish residue
4. Temperature and humidity check — coating must be applied within specified conditions
5. Coating applied panel by panel in thin, even layers using applicator block and suede applicator
6. Levelling of high spots with clean microfibre towel
7. IR lamp curing (premium packages) — accelerates initial cross-linking
8. 24-hour cure time — vehicle must remain dry and undisturbed
9. Final inspection and customer walkthrough
10. Aftercare guidance provided — wash protocol, products to use and avoid

### How Mobile Valeting Works (Step by Step)

1. Customer books via phone (07375 759686), WhatsApp, or website contact form
2. Date, time and location confirmed (home, office, or other)
3. Detailer arrives in fully equipped van
4. Vehicle assessed — condition noted, any specific concerns raised by customer addressed
5. Pre-wash: snow foam applied via lance, left to dwell, rinsed off
6. Wheels and arches cleaned first with dedicated brushes and fallout remover
7. Two-bucket contact wash — grit guard in each bucket, regular rinse of wash mitt
8. Rinse and blow-dry with air blower, hand dry with plush microfibre
9. Interior cleaned: vacuum, wipe-down, glass, fragrance
10. Final exterior detail: quick detailer, tyre dressing, door shuts
11. Customer walkround — satisfaction confirmed before detailer leaves

## Frequently Asked Questions — Extended

**Does SRV Detailing serve [specific area]?**
If the area is within Greater Manchester, Cheshire, or Warrington, the answer is almost certainly yes. Call 07375 759686 to confirm coverage for your specific postcode.

**What is the best way to protect a new car's paint?**
New car protection — applying a ceramic coating within the first few weeks of ownership — provides the best long-term paint protection. Factory paint has not yet been contaminated or damaged, making it the ideal substrate for ceramic coating. SRV Detailing's new car protection packages start from £250.

**How do I remove pet hair from car seats?**
Professional pet hair removal uses specialist rubber tools and professional-grade extraction equipment to lift and remove embedded pet hair that household vacuums cannot reach. SRV Detailing's pet hair removal service starts from £40.

**What is the best way to get rid of car odours?**
Professional odour removal using ozone treatment eliminates odours at the source rather than masking them. SRV Detailing's odour removal service (from £50) targets pet smells, cigarette smoke, food odours, and damp/mould.

**Why does my car have swirl marks?**
Swirl marks are caused by incorrect washing technique: automated car washes with rotating brushes, single-bucket washing (dirt dragged across paint), chamois leather drying, and drive-through jet washes. Professional paint correction permanently removes existing swirl marks; professional hand washing prevents new ones.

**Can ceramic coating be applied to a car with existing scratches?**
Ceramic coating bonds to the paint surface as it exists — it will follow the contours of any existing scratches, not fill them. Paint correction should always be performed before ceramic coating to ensure the corrected surface is protected, not the defective one.

**What aftercare does ceramic coating need?**
A ceramic-coated vehicle should be washed regularly (every 2–4 weeks) using pH-neutral shampoo, avoiding automated car washes. An annual ceramic coating maintenance service (coating booster application) is recommended to maintain hydrophobic performance and extend durability.

**How much does car detailing cost for an SUV?**
SUV pricing is approximately 20–30% higher than standard hatchback pricing. A full valet for an SUV starts from approximately £90–£100. Paint correction (multi-stage) for an SUV starts from approximately £320–£380. Ceramic coating (entry) for an SUV starts from approximately £380–£450. Contact SRV Detailing for an exact quote.

**Is it worth detailing a car before selling it?**
Yes. A professionally detailed car consistently achieves a higher sale price and sells faster than one in poor condition. Interior detailing and paint correction significantly improve first impressions. Customers report achieving £200–£1,000 more on vehicle sale price following a professional detail.
